# orbivisor_volume (Resource)

A volume (disk or ISO) in a storage pool. Changing the pool or format is not possible in place; size only grows.

Manifest kind `Volume`: the attributes are the manifest spec's fields in the server's JSON shape. Attributes left out keep the server's value; removing one sets the server default.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "orbivisor_volume" "web01_root" {
  name       = "web01-root"
  pool       = "local"
  size_bytes = 40 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name (unique per kind; DNS label). Changing it replaces the object.
- `pool` (String) Storage pool name.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size in bytes (grows in place; shrinking is refused).

### Optional

- `content` (String) `disk` (default) or `iso`.
- `format` (String) `qcow2` or `raw` (default: the pool's).
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels. Terraform owns the object's labels: labels set elsewhere are removed on the next apply (server labels `orbivisor.io/…` stay).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The manifest key: the name (folders `tree:/path`, grants the grant's content).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import orbivisor_volume.web01_root web01-root
```
